purpose: Prospectively determine whether completed-path information supports a calibrated negative veto, a positive admission, or only unknown abstention after static context and full loop-score combinations failed on opened 2024.

findings: Context-only payoff AUC was 0.534 and did not securely improve log-loss over predictions.
Adding all 20 loop compatibility scores worsened context log-loss by 0.00509 on average, with a session-block interval wholly below zero for improvement.
One-to-three-bar sequential path state reached AUC 0.588 but no calibrated point or conservative expected-net estimate crossed zero.
All primary and point diagnostic equations abstained on every primary opportunity.
A post-inspection raw-probability tail looked positive but was not monotonic, used a hindsight global percentile, and cannot define an activation threshold.
The low sequential-probability tail was strongly negative descriptively and motivates a prospective veto hypothesis only.

activation_requirements: Set an immutable activation timestamp before the first new observation.
Use only genuinely unseen sessions after model source, causal features, costs, calibration, support, and evaluation code are hashed.
Log the full eligible population before positive, negative, or unknown classification.
Keep alert, completed checkpoint, hypothetical next-open admission, and sealed outcome ledgers separate.
Do not choose a probability percentile, confirmation checkpoint, target, stop, horizon, calibration neighbourhood, or support threshold from opened 2024 tails.
Do not activate or implement through the trading application without separate explicit authorization.

frozen_targets.positive: lower uncertainty bound of cost-adjusted target-before-invalidation expectancy above zero
frozen_targets.negative_veto: upper uncertainty bound of cost-adjusted expectancy below zero
frozen_targets.accuracy: precision conditional on class jointly reported with coverage
frozen_targets.economic_target: net payoff per full eligible opportunity as well as per selected observation

prospective_hypotheses.claim: One-to-three completed bars may identify a calibrated negative payoff state with nonzero stable coverage.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: No bottom-tail threshold from opened 2024 may be reused.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: Sequential path state may eventually identify a positive expectancy class once genuinely prospective support exists.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: The opened raw top-five-percent diagnostic is not a rule, threshold, or validation result.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: Loop scores remain structural context and must demonstrate incremental prospective payoff value before entering an admission equation.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: The full opened-2024 loop vector cannot be retuned or interaction-mined.

required_fields: all frozen prediction or loop compatibility scores with mass and availability timestamp
causal local context at the completed decision bar
one, two, and three completed-bar path snapshots
structural risk and risk-specific break-even probability
raw and causally calibrated target-first probabilities
positive, negative, or unknown state with uncertainty and support
target, invalidation, no-touch, MFE, MAE, gross, and net outcomes opened only after window close
evaluation: calibration and log-loss against prior-only baselines
positive and negative precision with coverage
paired net payoff per full opportunity
independent source, timestamp, leakage, outcome-seal, and exact-rerun audit

provenance.market_or_sector_context: must come from a separately frozen timestamp-audited source
